theme: Light theme with botanical organic soft tones

brand_identity.name: Delora — Bloom & Gift
brand_identity.tone: Artisanal, serene, warm, precise, modern Indonesian UMKM financial companion
brand_identity.logo_style: Serif display 'DELORA' + script italic sub-brand 'Bloom & Gift'

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-[#2E3B34]
scale.kpi_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-[#2E3B34]
scale.caption: text-xs font-sans text-[#85978C]

mobile_navigation.bottom_bar: fixed bottom-3 left-3 right-3 z-40 h-16 rounded-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border border-[#E6E2D8] shadow-lg flex items-center justify-around px-3 md:hidden
mobile_navigation.drawer_modal: full-screen or slide-over drawer with smooth transition

responsive_rules.tables: Desktop: clean stripped/hover table with clear headers. Mobile (<= 768px): automatic conversion into styled card lists with clear badges and action buttons.

kpi_cards.wrapper: bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#E6E2D8] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden group
kpi_cards.accent_bar: absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#8CAA9A] to-[#E8D9B8]
kpi_cards.icon_wrapper: w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#F2F7F4] text-[#8CAA9A] flex items-center justify-center font-semibold

buttons.primary: bg-[#8CAA9A] hover:bg-[#7A9988] text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#FAF6ED] hover:bg-[#E8D9B8]/40 text-[#6B582C] font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E8D9B8] transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.outline: bg-white hover:bg-[#F2F7F4] text-[#2E3B34] font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#E6E2D8] transition-all duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.danger: bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-red-200 transition-all duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2

badges.belum_lunas: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200
badges.setengah_lunas: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200
badges.selesai_lunas: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200
badges.stok_minimum: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 animate-pulse

modals.container: bg-white rounded-3xl md:rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl border border-[#E6E2D8] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto
modals.mobile_fullscreen: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-white p-5 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col justify-between sm:static sm:h-auto sm:max-w-xl sm:rounded-2xl sm:shadow-2xl

forms.input: w-full bg-[#FDFBF7] border border-[#E6E2D8] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-[#2E3B34] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8CAA9A]/40 focus:border-[#8CAA9A] transition-all duration-200 placeholder:text-slate-400
forms.currency_input: w-full bg-[#FDFBF7] border border-[#E6E2D8] rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 font-mono text-[#2E3B34] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8CAA9A]/40 focus:border-[#8CAA9A]
forms.select: w-full bg-[#FDFBF7] border border-[#E6E2D8] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-[#2E3B34] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8CAA9A]/40

charts.recharts_area: Primary stroke: #8CAA9A, fill gradient: #8CAA9A with opacity 0.25 to 0.05. Secondary stroke: #E8D9B8
charts.tooltip: bg-[#1F2823] text-white rounded-xl shadow-xl p-3 text-xs

pages_guide.Dashboard: KPI Cards (Penjualan, Piutang, Kas/Bank, Stok Alert), 5 Panel Saldo Akun dengan icon botanical & border cream, Chart Penjualan vs Pengeluaran, Riwayat Transaksi Terbaru.
pages_guide.Inventory: Banner Stok Minimum teratas (merah soft glowing), Switch/Filter Kategori Bouquet vs Materials, Quick Add Stock button, Table/Card list stok.
pages_guide.Expenses: Quick Expense Form modal, Pie/Bar chart breakdown kategori biaya, Tabel Riwayat Biaya.
pages_guide.Sales: 4 Tab Form Penjualan (Standard, Pre-order, Instant, Custom Bouquet), Multi-item calculator, Tabel Riwayat Penjualan.
pages_guide.Purchases: Modal 3 Tab Pembelian Bahan, Tabel Riwayat Pembelian & supplier details.
pages_guide.Orders: 5 Tab Form Pesanan Kompleks (Semua, DP/Belum, Diproses, Ready, Selesai), Grouped expand/collapse per status, Quick View Modal, Completion Modal.
pages_guide.Customers: Grid Kartu Pelanggan dengan avatar inisial berwarna Sage/Cream, total piutang, dan riwayat pesanan.
pages_guide.FixedAssets: Metode penyusutan aset tetap (garis lurus), tabel aset, kalkulasi akumulasi penyusutan.
pages_guide.CashBank: Transfer antar kas/bank modal, panel 5 akun kas (Kas Utama, BCA, Mandiri, QRIS, E-Wallet), log mutasi.

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, tab, modal toggle, and form field MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts URL into index.html: Cormorant Garamond, Plus Jakarta Sans, Caveat, JetBrains Mono.
Ensure all interactive components use proper state & micro-animations with Framer Motion or smooth Tailwind transitions.
Apply testids to all interactive elements to support UI tests.
Maintain the light organic botanical feel with Sage Green (#8CAA9A), Cream (#E8D9B8), Forest Ink (#2E3B34) and warm backgrounds (#FDFBF7).
